name: Elan Paradise
summary: Existence, developer (Elan Group), Nirvana Country / Sector 50 location and 4-acre land area are confirmed. Our RERA number GGM/447/179/2021/15 is Phase 1; a second registration (GGM/584/316/2022/59) also exists. Our ₹2.5 Cr starting price is more than double the portals' ₹0.98-1.12 Cr. Our September 2026 possession is not stated anywhere: sources give September 2025 or June 2026, and some list the project as ready to move.
